rows.prompt: What do jellyfish use stinging cells mainly to do?
rows.note: Cnidarian stinging cells aid prey capture and defence, not seed chewing or nest building.

rows.note: Oysters are two-shelled molluscs (bivalves), not crustaceans, fishes or worms.

rows.prompt: What is seasonal migration in animals?
rows.note: Seasonal migration is recurring movement between areas at different seasons; the alternatives are not geographic movement.
